title: The Aunnāda Model: A Model of Cosmic Formation from the Primordial Source
content: This paper proposes the "aunnāda model," a cosmological framework based on the hypothesis that all observable structures arise from the resonance of fundamental units called aun. Each aun is characterized by its spin rotation period (srp), spin direction, vibration period, and vibration deflection angle (vda). When multiple auns enter resonance, they form aunnāda, and higher-order structures emerge through composite resonances. This model attempts to explain fundamental physical quantities (mass, charge, gravity), quantum behavior, entanglement, and even thermal and vacuum phenomena, not by external causes but through internal resonance alignment. This approach aims to provide a new foundation for understanding the origin of the universe and the nature of reality.
